item.title: Reconstructing cloud-free Sentinel-2 time series under complex degradations with state-driven spatio-temporal modeling
item.description:
中文标题：状态驱动时空建模下复杂退化条件的无云Sentinel-2时间序列重建

作者：Ziyang LiHe, Qiangqiang Yuan, Jiang He, Liupeng Lin, Xianyu Jin, Huanfeng Shen, Liangpei Zhang

中文摘要：由于摘要为空，无法提供具体内容摘要。根据标题可知，该研究提出一种状态驱动的时空建模方法，用于在复杂退化条件下重建无云Sentinel-2时间序列，发表于Remote Sensing of Environment。

研究启发（模型推断）：从标题推断，该工作可能针对云污染等复杂退化问题，通过状态驱动的时空建模提升Sentinel-2时间序列的连续性与可用性，或可为变化检测提供更可靠的数据基础；但因摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法、数据与结论。

相关度：68/100 该论文研究复杂退化条件下无云Sentinel-2时间序列重建，采用状态驱动的时空建模，属于遥感时间序列处理与多源数据融合方向，与遥感变化检测和时空数据挖掘高度相关。

item.title: Geospatial Foundation Models Capture Health-Relevant Dimensions of Place Beyond Conventional Social Risk Indices
item.description:
中文标题：地理空间基础模型捕捉超越传统社会风险指数的健康相关场所维度

作者：Nathaniel Hendrix, Carl Y. Zhang, Chris Heitzig, Andrew Bazemore, David H. Rehkopf

Abstract: Area-based social risk indices summarize residents' socioeconomic conditions but incompletely capture physical features of place that may affect health. We evaluated whether numerical representations of physical place produced by four geospatial foundation model families from 2022 satellite data explained residual variance in tract-level associations between the Area Deprivation Index, Social Deprivation Index, and Social Vulnerability Index with health outcomes. We used LightGBM to predict variables from the American Community Survey and 40 chronic disease and health-behavior outcomes from CDC PLACES across 82,646 census tracts in the contiguous United States, evaluating performance across 10 held-out states. Among survey variables, models were moderately predictive of some variables including housing type (R-squared up to 0.54) but weak for disability, unemployment, and income disparity. For health outcomes, models explained up to 54% of variance left unexplained by social risk indices, with the largest gains for annual checkups, arthritis, and high blood pressure. Mean total variance explained by geospatial foundation models across the 40 health-related outcomes increased from 0.31 in the smallest tract-size decile to 0.39 in the largest. Geospatial foundation models capture health-relevant features of place not represented by conventional social risk indices and may usefully augment them in epidemiological analyses.

中文摘要：基于区域的社会风险指数总结了居民的社会经济状况，但可能无法完整捕捉可能影响健康的场所物理特征。我们评估了四个地理空间基础模型家族基于2022年卫星数据生成的场所数值表示，是否能够解释区域剥夺指数、社会剥夺指数和社会脆弱性指数与健康结果之间在普查区层面关联的残差方差。我们使用LightGBM从美国社区调查变量和CDC PLACES的40种慢性病及健康行为结果中预测变量，覆盖美国本土82,646个普查区，并在10个留出州评估性能。在调查变量中，模型对某些变量（包括住房类型，R平方最高达0.54）具有中等预测能力，但对残疾、失业和收入差距预测较弱。对于健康结果，模型解释了社会风险指数未能解释的方差中最高达54%的部分，在年度体检、关节炎和高血压方面增益最大。地理空间基础模型在40种健康相关结果中解释的平均总方差从最小普查区规模十分位的0.31增加到最大十分位的0.39。地理空间基础模型捕捉了传统社会风险指数未表示的健康相关场所特征，可能有助于在流行病学分析中对其进行补充。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究表明地理空间基础模型嵌入可能补充传统社会风险指数，但其解释力在不同普查区规模和健康结果间存在差异，提示在应用时需考虑空间尺度效应。

相关度：65/100 该研究评估地理空间基础模型捕捉健康相关场所特征的能力，与GIS博士研究中多源数据融合和地理空间智能相关，但主题偏向健康地理学而非城市更新或时空数据挖掘。

item.title: R4Tun: LLM-guided adaptive segmental tunnel lining segmentation in point clouds
item.description:
中文标题：R4Tun：LLM引导的自适应分段隧道衬砌点云分割

作者：Xinghui Tao, Zehao Ye, Guangming Wang, Jelena Nini\'c, Brian Sheil

Abstract: Automated inspection of segmental tunnel linings requires adaptive segmentation from 3D point clouds, yet expert-tuned pipelines often degrade when tunnel conditions vary. This paper presents R4Tun, a large language model (LLM)-driven adaptation framework that extends an expert-designed pipeline (SAM4Tun) with bounded parameter tuning informed by structured context: memory ($m$), state ($s$), and knowledge ($k$). Evaluated on 30 selected Seg2Tunnel subsets (13 regular, 17 complex) across three LLMs, the full $m+s+k$ design raised mean Intersection-over-Union (mIoU) from 0.18 to 0.43--0.48 and overall accuracy (OA) from 0.42 to 0.59--0.65 relative to the static SAM4Tun baseline, with the near-reference regular (staggered) subsets reaching mIoU 0.784--0.796 across LLMs. Across 270 (30 tunnels $\times$ 3 different LLMs $\times$ 3 context settings) runs, the LLMs showed similar parameter-adjustment trends (with overlapping 95\% CIs on mean gains) and consistently adjusted a shared set of critical parameters. These results support R4Tun as a controlled, label-free, cross-LLM adaptation mechanism in the tested SAM4Tun--Seg2Tunnel setting, demonstrating consistent accuracy gains; we position R4Tun as a mechanism contribution rather than a deployable final-inspection system, in which each bounded parameter change is auditable via logged rationales.

中文摘要：分段隧道衬砌的自动化检测需要从三维点云中进行自适应分割，但专家调优的流程在隧道条件变化时往往性能下降。本文提出R4Tun，一种由大语言模型驱动的自适应框架，通过结构化上下文（记忆m、状态s和知识k）对专家设计的流程SAM4Tun进行有界参数调优。在30个选定的Seg2Tunnel子集（13个规则、17个复杂）上使用三种LLM进行评估，完整的m+s+k设计将平均交并比（mIoU）从0.18提升至0.43–0.48，总体准确率（OA）从0.42提升至0.59–0.65，相比静态SAM4Tun基线显著改善；接近参考的规则（交错）子集在三种LLM上达到mIoU 0.784–0.796。在270次运行（30条隧道×3种不同LLM×3种上下文设置）中，各LLM表现出相似的参数调整趋势（平均增益的95%置信区间重叠），并持续调整一组共享的关键参数。这些结果支持R4Tun在测试的SAM4Tun–Seg2Tunnel设置中作为一种受控、无标签、跨LLM的自适应机制，展示出一致的精度提升；作者将R4Tun定位为机制贡献而非可部署的最终检测系统，其中每次有界参数变化都可通过日志化理由进行审计。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作表明LLM可通过结构化上下文对专家点云处理流程进行有界参数调优，从而在隧道条件变化时提升分割鲁棒性；其无标签、可审计的跨LLM自适应机制或可迁移到其他地理空间点云处理任务，但论文强调其仍属机制贡献而非可部署系统。

相关度：72/100 该论文提出LLM引导的自适应分段隧道衬砌点云分割框架，将大语言模型用于专家流程的参数调优，与LLM、多智能体和地理空间智能研究高度相关，同时涉及三维点云与基础设施检测。

item.title: But How Would AI Agents Run a Town's Economy?
item.description:
中文标题：但AI智能体将如何运行一个城镇的经济？

作者：Sajal Regmi, Siddhartha Pudasaini, Chetan Phakami Pun

Abstract: We placed 100 memory-equipped large language model (LLM) agents in charge of a closed, money-conserving spatial economy on real Pokhara Lakeside geography (earning wages, running businesses, setting prices) and ran this multi-agent simulation for up to 26 simulated weeks, well past the 1-2 weeks typical of agent-society studies. Across 91 validated runs (2.44M agent decisions, 21.5B tokens), the money stops moving, in a specific and measurable way. A 12x tourist demand shock raises business revenue 4.62x ($p<0.001$), which we decompose exactly into a 1.50x extensive margin (more businesses trading) and a 3.07x intensive margin (more revenue each). Monetary transmission stops there. Wages move 1.03x ($p=0.42$); 0.3% of 3,981 menu items are ever repriced ($p=0.47$). A randomized cash transfer (NPR 5,000 to 20 of 100 agents) shows the same pattern from the opposite direction: 96.7% is still held 311 pulses later, marginal propensity to consume 3-4% by two independent measures, indistinguishable from zero. The wealth distribution is consequently near-frozen at the horizon this literature uses ($\rho=0.964$ over 2 simulated weeks), but not frozen. $\rho$ falls to 0.832 at 12 weeks and 0.752 at 26, a horizon-dependence no short study can see. Matched ablations show which knob actually matters. Swapping the backing LLM moves every outcome we measure ($p=0.0039$); deleting agents' memory moves none of them detectably. A purely social tool fails 94-97% of the time across two model families, compared with ~96% success on economic tools, with no measurable shift away from it. Every headline number is verified twice, by a live validator and by an offline recomputation that reconciles each agent's wealth against its own signed transaction history, and we release the full run corpus for reanalysis.

中文摘要：我们将100个具备记忆的大语言模型（LLM）智能体置于真实博卡拉湖滨地理环境上的一个封闭、货币守恒的空间经济中（赚取工资、经营企业、设定价格），并运行该多智能体仿真长达26个模拟周，远超智能体社会研究典型的1–2周。在91次有效运行（244万次智能体决策、215亿token）中，货币以特定且可度量的方式停止流动。12倍旅游需求冲击使企业收入提高4.62倍（p<0.001），我们将其精确分解为1.50倍的广延边际（更多企业交易）和3.07倍的集约边际（每家企业收入更高）。货币传导到此为止。工资变动1.03倍（p=0.42）；3981个菜单项中仅0.3%曾被重新定价（p=0.47）。一项随机现金转移（向100个智能体中的20个发放5000尼泊尔卢比）从相反方向显示出相同模式：311个脉冲后仍有96.7%被持有，边际消费倾向按两种独立度量均为3–4%，与零无法区分。因此财富分布在该文献常用的时间尺度上近乎冻结（2个模拟周内ρ=0.964），但并非完全冻结。ρ在12周时降至0.832，在26周时降至0.752，这种时间尺度依赖性任何短期研究都无法看到。匹配消融实验显示了真正起作用的因素。更换底层LLM会改变我们测量的每一项结果（p=0.0039）；删除智能体记忆则没有可检测地改变任何结果。一种纯社交工具在两个模型家族中失败率为94–97%，而经济工具成功率约为96%，且没有可测量的偏离。每个核心数字都经过两次验证，一次由实时验证器完成，一次由离线重算完成，后者将每个智能体的财富与其自身带符号的交易历史进行核对，我们发布了完整运行语料库。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究显示，在真实地理环境中的LLM多智能体经济仿真中，货币传导在收入层面即停止，工资与价格几乎不动，且财富分布的时间尺度依赖性显著；同时底层LLM选择影响结果而记忆删除影响不显著。这提示基于LLM智能体的空间经济模拟需关注模型选择与仿真时长，其地理空间设置或可为城市与区域经济仿真提供参考。

相关度：78/100 该论文将100个具备记忆的LLM智能体置于真实博卡拉湖滨地理环境中运行封闭空间经济仿真，直接涉及多智能体、LLM、地理空间与时空过程，与多智能体、LLM和地理空间智能研究高度相关。

中文摘要：我们将100个具备记忆的大语言模型（LLM）智能体置于真实博卡拉湖滨地理环境上的一个封闭、货币守恒的空间经济中（赚取工资、经营企业、设定价格），并运行该多智能体仿真长达26个模拟周，远超智能体社会研究典型的1–2周。在91次有效运行（244万次智能体决策、215亿token）中，货币以特定且可度量的方式停止流动。12倍旅游需求冲击使企业收入提高4.62倍（p<0.001），我们将其精确分解为1.50倍的广延边际（更多企业交易）和3.07倍的集约边际（每家企业收入更高）。货币传导到此为止。工资变动1.03倍（p=0.42）；3981个菜单项中仅0.3%曾被重新定价（p=0.47）。一项随机现金转移（向100个智能体中的20个发放5000尼泊尔卢比）从相反方向显示出相同模式：311个脉冲后仍有96.7%被持有，边际消费倾向按两种独立度量均为3–4%，与零无法区分。因此财富分布在该文献常用的时间尺度上近乎冻结（2个模拟周内ρ=0.964），但并非完全冻结。ρ在12周时降至0.832，在26周时降至0.752，这种时间尺度依赖性任何短期研究都无法看到。匹配消融实验显示了真正起作用的因素。更换底层LLM会改变我们测量的每一项结果（p=0.0039）；删除智能体记忆则没有可检测地改变任何结果。一种纯社交工具在两个模型家族中失败率为94–97%，而经济工具成功率约为96%，且没有可测量的偏离。每个核心数字都经过两次验证，一次由实时验证器完成，一次由离线重算完成，后者将每个智能体的财富与其自身带符号的交易历史进行核对，我们发布了完整运行语料库。

相关度：78/100 该论文将100个具备记忆的LLM智能体置于真实博卡拉湖滨地理环境中运行封闭空间经济仿真，直接涉及多智能体、LLM、地理空间与时空过程，与多智能体、LLM和地理空间智能研究高度相关。

item.title: Comparative Study of Anatomical and Learned Features in AI Models for Structural Brain MRI
item.description:
中文标题：结构脑MRI AI模型中解剖特征与学习特征的比较研究

作者：Boyang Yu, Miquel Lopez Escoriza, Long Chen, Arjun V. Masurkar, Narges Razavian, Carlos Fernandez-Granda

Abstract: In this work, we comprehensively evaluate three popular feature-extraction paradigms in AI-based neuroimaging modeling: (1) computation of anatomical surfaces and volumes, (2) supervised learning with convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and (3) unsupervised pretraining of vision transformer (ViT) foundation models, followed by supervised finetuning. Our study is based on 18 publicly available datasets containing 3D structural T1-weighted MRI scans from approximately 80,000 participants across seven distinct clinical tasks. We observe that a linear model based on anatomical features matches the diagnostic performance of complex nonlinear features learned by sophisticated AI frameworks, including foundation models trained on thousands of scans. Conversely, CNNs and pretrained ViTs learn features that implicitly capture relevant anatomical information, bypassing the need for explicit feature extraction. Building upon these insights, we propose Anatomy Segmentation Pretraining (ASP), a novel method to incorporate anatomical information during foundation-model pretraining, which outperforms existing models in biological age estimation.

中文摘要：该研究基于18个公开数据集（约8万参与者，7项临床任务），比较了三种特征提取范式：解剖表面和体积计算、CNN监督学习、以及ViT基础模型的无监督预训练加监督微调。研究发现，基于解剖特征的线性模型能达到与复杂AI框架相当的诊断性能，并据此提出了解剖分割预训练方法，在生物年龄估计上优于现有模型。

研究启发（模型推断）：在特定任务上，显式的领域知识（如解剖特征）可以提供与复杂深度学习模型相当的性能，而将此类知识融入基础模型预训练过程，可以进一步提升模型在下游任务上的表现。

相关度：65/100 该研究系统比较了基于解剖特征、CNN和监督微调ViT基础模型在脑MRI分析中的性能，并提出了将解剖信息融入预训练的新方法。这与研究者在多源数据融合和地理空间智能方面的兴趣相关，特别是关于如何有效利用领域知识（解剖/地理）来增强深度学习模型性能的探讨。

item.title: NS-ST-GraphRAG: Neuro-Symbolic Spatio-Temporal GraphRAG for Literary Knowledge Processing
item.description:
中文标题：NS-ST-GraphRAG：用于文学知识处理的神经符号时空图RAG

作者：Zheng Kui Lin

Abstract: Long-form literary narratives pose a distinctive information-processing challenge for retrieval-augmented generation: relevant evidence is distributed across chapters, relations evolve over narrative time, and correct answers may depend jointly on temporal, spatial, and relational constraints. We propose NS-ST-GraphRAG, a neuro-symbolic spatio-temporal GraphRAG framework that integrates ontology-guided extraction, deterministic constraint checking, dual temporal coordinates, spatial scene attributes, and dynamic sub-graph retrieval. Instead of retrieving from a single corpus-level graph, the framework selects the graph state valid for the temporal and spatial scope of a query and grounds generated answers in traceable evidence. We further introduce Red-Chamber-QA, to our knowledge the first open multi-hop question-answering benchmark for classical Chinese literature, with time-, space-, and general-question categories, per-part evidence spans, and deterministic shortcut controls. On a 120-question held-out split, NS-ST-GraphRAG achieves mechanical answer reproduction of 0.733 versus 0.675 for the frozen window baseline and 0.083 for a closed-book model (McNemar exact p = 0.092, directionally favorable but not significant); semantic-judge accuracy is 0.866 versus 0.850. The pre-specified constrained-category condition of H2 is not supported by the delivered comparison. These results show how temporal graph representation, constrained extraction, and auditable evaluation integrate into a unified framework for verifiable knowledge processing over long-form narrative.

中文摘要：提出NS-ST-GraphRAG框架，结合本体引导抽取、确定性约束检查、双时间坐标和空间场景属性，实现长篇小说中基于时空约束的检索增强生成。并引入了首个面向中国古典文学的多跳问答基准Red-Chamber-QA。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究为在复杂叙事中处理时空约束信息提供了方法论参考，其动态子图检索和可审计评估机制对构建可解释的时空知识问答系统具有借鉴意义。

相关度：65/100 论文提出一种神经符号的时空图RAG框架，用于处理长文本中的时空关系推理，其核心思想与用户研究中时空数据挖掘和LLM的结合点相关，但应用领域为文学。

item.title: Unlearning on Spatio-Temporal Graphs through Subgraph Virtual Edge Reconstruction
item.description:
中文标题：通过子图虚拟边重建实现时空图上的数据遗忘

作者：Qiming Guo, Wenbo Sun, Chen Pan, Ye Wang, Wenlu Wang

Abstract: Spatio-temporal graphs are widely used in modeling complex dynamic processes such as temporal forecasting, molecular dynamics, and healthcare monitoring. Recently, stringent privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA have introduced significant new challenges for existing spatio-temporal graph models, requiring complete unlearning of unauthorized data. Since each node in a spatio-temporal graph diffuses information globally across both spatial and temporal dimensions, existing unlearning methods primarily designed for static graphs and localized data removal cannot efficiently erase a single node without incurring costs nearly equivalent to full model retraining. To address this, we propose CallosumNet, a spatio-temporal graph unlearning framework biologically inspired by the corpus callosum structure. CallosumNet makes two key technical contributions: (1) it reconstructs subgraphs using biologically-inspired virtual edges; and (2) it restores interlinked spatio-temporal dependencies among subgraphs via a lightweight meta-graph integration layer. Empirical results on four diverse real-world datasets show that CallosumNet achieves complete unlearning while maintaining accuracy very close to the gold model. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/wenlu-lab/STGraphUnlearning.

中文摘要：提出CallosumNet框架，用于高效地从时空图模型中遗忘单个节点数据。通过生物启发的虚拟边重建子图，并利用轻量级元图集成层恢复子图间的时空依赖，在四个数据集上验证了其有效性。

研究启发（模型推断）：利用虚拟边和元图结构，可以在不显著损失模型精度的前提下实现高效的时空图数据遗忘，为隐私合规提供了新方法。

相关度：65/100 论文研究时空图上的数据遗忘问题，涉及图神经网络与时空建模，与GIS中的时空数据挖掘有一定关联，但更偏向于机器学习隐私。

item.title: ARGOS: Who, Where, and When in Agentic Multi-Camera Person Search
item.description:
中文标题：ARGOS：智能体多摄像头行人搜索中的谁、何地、何时

作者：Myungchul Kim, Kwanyong Park, Junmo Kim, In So Kweon

Abstract: Existing person search methods assume access to complete visual queries or exhaustive tracking, yet real-world witness accounts are vague, partial, and spread across cameras and time. We introduce ARGOS (Agentic Retrieval with Grounded Observational Search), a benchmark and agent framework that recasts multi-camera person search from one-shot retrieval on a complete query into interactive reasoning from partial clues. To our knowledge, ARGOS is the first interactive benchmark to couple witness dialogue with camera-network topology, requiring an agent to plan, question, and eliminate under information asymmetry. An ARGOS agent receives a vague witness statement and must decide what to ask, when to invoke spatial or temporal tools, and how to interpret ambiguous natural-language responses, all within a limited turn budget. To ground reasoning in physical constraints, the agent accesses a Spatio-Temporal Topology Graph (STTG) encoding camera connectivity and empirically validated transition times. The benchmark comprises 2{,}691 tasks across 14 real-world scenarios in three progressive tracks: semantic perception (\emph{Who}, 989 tasks), spatial reasoning (\emph{Where}, 550 tasks), and temporal reasoning (\emph{When}, 1{,}152 tasks). We propose Turn-Weighted Success (TWS) as the primary metric, jointly measuring correctness and turn efficiency. Experiments with four LLM backbones show the benchmark is far from solved: the best agent achieves TWS of 0.383 (Track~2) and 0.590 (Track~3). Ablations confirm each component is essential: removing domain-specific tools drops Top-1 accuracy by up to 49.6 percentage points, and removing strategic reasoning halves TWS while barely affecting Top-1.

中文摘要：提出ARGOS基准和智能体框架，将多摄像头行人搜索从基于完整查询的一次性检索转变为基于部分线索的交互式推理。智能体需在有限轮次内决定提问内容、调用时空工具并解读模糊的自然语言回答，通过时空拓扑图进行物理约束下的推理。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究揭示了在信息不对称条件下，智能体需要具备主动提问和策略性工具调用的能力，而不仅仅是依赖强大的感知模型，这为设计更复杂的时空推理智能体提供了新的评估维度和思路。

相关度：70/100 该研究构建了基于LLM的多智能体框架，用于多摄像头下的行人搜索，涉及时空推理、工具调用和策略规划，与LLM和多智能体研究方向高度相关，但应用场景为视频监控，与城市更新和遥感变化检测的关联较弱。

item.title: Event-Based De-Snowing for Autonomous Driving
item.description:
中文标题：基于事件的自动驾驶去雪方法

作者：Manasi Muglikar, Nico Messikommer, Marco Cannici, Davide Scaramuzza

Abstract: Adverse weather conditions, particularly heavy snowfall, pose significant challenges to both human drivers and autonomous vehicles. Traditional image-based de-snowing methods often introduce hallucination artifacts as they rely solely on spatial information, while video-based approaches require high frame rates and suffer from alignment artifacts at lower frame rates. Camera parameters, such as exposure time, also influence the appearance of snowflakes, making the problem difficult to solve and heavily dependent on network generalization. In this paper, we propose to address the challenge of desnowing by using event cameras, which offer compressed visual information with submillisecond latency, making them ideal for de-snowing images, even in the presence of ego-motion. Our method leverages the fact that snowflake occlusions appear with a very distinctive streak signature in the spatio-temporal representation of event data. We design an attention-based module that focuses on events along these streaks to determine when a background point was occluded and use this information to recover its original intensity. We benchmark our method on DSEC-Snow, a new dataset created using a green-screen technique that overlays pre-recorded snowfall data onto the existing DSEC driving dataset, resulting in precise ground truth and synchronized image and event streams. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art de-snowing methods by 3 dB in PSNR for image reconstruction. Moreover, we show that off-the-shelf computer vision algorithms can be applied to our reconstructions for tasks such as depth estimation and optical flow, achieving a $20\%$ performance improvement over other de-snowing methods. Our work represents a crucial step towards enhancing the reliability and safety of vision systems in challenging winter conditions, paving the way for more robust, all-weather-capable applications.

中文摘要：针对大雪天气对自动驾驶的挑战，提出利用事件相机进行去雪。方法利用雪花在事件数据的时空表示中产生的独特条纹特征，设计基于注意力的模块来识别背景点被遮挡的时刻并恢复其原始强度。在DSEC-Snow数据集上，该方法在图像重建的PSNR上比最先进的去雪方法高出3dB，并提升了深度估计和光流等下游任务的性能。

研究启发（模型推断）：事件相机的高时间分辨率特性为处理恶劣天气下的动态遮挡提供了新思路，其独特的时空条纹特征可作为识别和恢复被遮挡信息的有效线索。

相关度：70/100 该研究利用事件相机进行去雪和图像重建，涉及多模态数据融合和图像处理，与多源数据融合和地理空间智能的研究方向有一定关联，但主要面向自动驾驶场景，与城市更新和遥感变化检测的直接关联较弱。

中文标题：基于事件的自动驾驶去雪方法

作者：Manasi Muglikar, Nico Messikommer, Marco Cannici, Davide Scaramuzza

Abstract: Adverse weather conditions, particularly heavy snowfall, pose significant challenges to both human drivers and autonomous vehicles. Traditional image-based de-snowing methods often introduce hallucination artifacts as they rely solely on spatial information, while video-based approaches require high frame rates and suffer from alignment artifacts at lower frame rates. Camera parameters, such as exposure time, also influence the appearance of snowflakes, making the problem difficult to solve and heavily dependent on network generalization. In this paper, we propose to address the challenge of desnowing by using event cameras, which offer compressed visual information with submillisecond latency, making them ideal for de-snowing images, even in the presence of ego-motion. Our method leverages the fact that snowflake occlusions appear with a very distinctive streak signature in the spatio-temporal representation of event data. We design an attention-based module that focuses on events along these streaks to determine when a background point was occluded and use this information to recover its original intensity. We benchmark our method on DSEC-Snow, a new dataset created using a green-screen technique that overlays pre-recorded snowfall data onto the existing DSEC driving dataset, resulting in precise ground truth and synchronized image and event streams. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art de-snowing methods by 3 dB in PSNR for image reconstruction. Moreover, we show that off-the-shelf computer vision algorithms can be applied to our reconstructions for tasks such as depth estimation and optical flow, achieving a $20\%$ performance improvement over other de-snowing methods. Our work represents a crucial step towards enhancing the reliability and safety of vision systems in challenging winter conditions, paving the way for more robust, all-weather-capable applications.
